title: App-context app (per-record frontmatter)
description: Frontmatter of app-context/src/apps/<slug>.md: the app's identity, header variant, navigation structure and use cases. It does NOT describe purpose, users or signals. Purpose and signals are authored as BODY sections (## Purpose, ## Signals) and lifted by scripts/app-context/derive-app-context.js; users are derived from the personas that list the app (app-context/src/personas/). All three are declared on the derived shape at schemas/app-context.json#/$defs/app. additionalProperties is false here, so declaring them in this file would permit frontmatter keys that can never legally appear.

slug.description: Kebab-case identifier for the app; used as the filename (minus .md) and cross-reference target.

label.description: Human-readable display name of the app shown in navigation and documentation.

header.description: Global-header configuration for the app; controls the DS header variant rendered at runtime.

type.description: Header variant; matches a DS global-header App type. Open by design so new apps can declare their own header.

context.description: The context switcher left of the search, as the product shows it.

search.description: The header search: the scope dropdown's value and the field's placeholder.

placeholder.description: The search field's placeholder, exactly as shown.

sidebar.description: Ordered list of primary navigation items shown in the app sidebar. The one record of the app's side navigation: consecutive items sharing a group are drawn together with a divider where it changes, items with position bottom are drawn together in the rail's bottom block, in order.

label.description: Display text for the navigation item, as the product shows it.

icon.description: Icon slug in components/dist/icons/icons.json. Omit when no source names the icon.

group.description: Consecutive items with the same group are drawn together; a divider where it changes.

position.description: Drawn in the rail's bottom-anchored block, in order.

kind.description: link (default) or action, such as New Item.

children.description: Sub-items drawn under the item. No nesting below them.

useCases.description: What the app is FOR, framed as audience → jobs. Optionally links each use case to app-scoped patterns. Drives flow framing + scaffold selection in consumers.

audience.description: Primary users this use case serves.

jobs.description: Jobs-to-be-done for this audience in this app.

patterns.description: App-scoped pattern slugs idiomatic to this use case. Integrity (exists + app-scoped) enforced by validate-app-context.js.
